sourceVerification.sourceAxes: X north, Y west, Z down
sourceVerification.note: Canonical data matches every source ID/TimeExact/position. Presentation yaw is configured separately from the canonical data; continuation after recorded samples is extrapolated.

encounterAudit.note: Real four-rig Swarm startup; audit one rig using its configured cameras at native 64/128 pixels, gray sky and current world positions. Contrast requires 3 bytes (any-byte count also reported) in a 5x5 patch around a moth within 3m. Overlapping moths can contribute to the same patch. This is numerical detectability, not a biological visibility threshold. Recorded samples/times are unchanged. Instantiation precedes first samples by preRollSeconds; incoming and outgoing extrapolation uses the configured physical speed.

resolutionAndRetention.note: 1024px is a resolution diagnostic, not a calibrated human-vision simulation. Native 64/1024 images share camera position, orientation, 90-degree FOV, world positions and wing phase. Stationary diagnostic uses 5s extrapolated lead-in; active 5m/s flight uses zero. No extra births, spatial compression, minimum opacity, or moth-size boost. Readbacks and image encoding are editor validation only.

playbackAndRendering.timingNote: Isolated CPU timings: four rigs, six 64px cameras each, 256 agents per rig. Not hardware-display FPS.

notes: Source +Z down was confirmed by the user. Corrected Y=5-sourceZ/1000; 14429 original observations and all ID/TimeExact values are preserved. Horizontal orientation and distance/speed statistics are unchanged by vertical reflection.

Active recipe retains the user's 3cm body, 1cm thickness, 6cm wingspan, 0.75 wing opacity and 5m/s observer. User-selected sky RGB is 0.1. Direct unlit moth RGB is explicitly 0.012 to create a dark silhouette; this is not calibrated photometry.
The single left/right wing pair was already present. Geometry and GPU upper/lower poses are checked; no extra wing pair, per-agent Animator or camera is added to player runtime.
Current hardware config requests 128px panels. Resolution tests explicitly render 64px and 1024px with identical poses and phase; 1024px is not a calibrated human-vision model.
Startup uses isolated hardware settings and disables tracker input. Its visibility counts use four horizontal faces; separate retention/resolution captures include all six faces.
Same RGB/background and native 8bit contrast are retained in captures. Mid-gray controls isolate resolution. No additional births, spatial compression, angular-size override or opacity floor is used.
Diagnostic image readbacks and high-resolution cameras run only in editor validation, never in the experimental player. Existing compact rendering and asynchronous logging remain unchanged.
